product.title: Trade Deadline War Room (Track 101)
product.summary: Two rounds of deadline trades against a luxury-tax line, pitched at Grades 5–6.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students run one of three franchises through a 12-screen deadline: read intel, pick a trade, watch four meters and the tax line move, absorb an ownership pressure moment that re-weights what matters, make a closing move, then defend it.

facilitation.notes: QA-CHECKLIST.md is a developer QA document, not a facilitator guide. A branching PowerPoint covering the same topic ships alongside and can be run on a projector.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: 28 unit tests pass, accessibility and reduced-motion handled, documented QA pass. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Strong production — team select, intel tabs, a mid-game ownership pressure beat and a mock newspaper ending with a 0-100 Front Office Score. Undermined by scoring that does not reward acting.
knownBlockers: Doing nothing beats going all in. Stand Pat followed by Trust the Room scored 69 out of 100; the most aggressive available path scored 66. That contradicts the decision screen's framing that every option carries a real cost.
The ownership pressure event fires the same quote verbatim regardless of the Round 1 choice, so it reads as reactive but is scripted.

governance.notes: Shares a title with trade-deadline-war-room-201. Evidence points to deliberate grade-band differentiation rather than accidental duplication, but this was never confirmed by a human.

provenance.evidence: T101-M1-L2/QA-CHECKLIST.md: 'Audience: 5th–6th grade. Topic: NBA salary cap & luxury tax.' and 'Acceptable for a ~5-minute activity.' tests/simulation.test.js reports 28 passing.
